text:
I've read every source file, test, config, and the committed demo artifacts. Here's the full review.

## Overall assessment

The craftsmanship is genuinely decent — clean module boundaries, type hints throughout, `yaml.safe_load`, no injection/path/security vulnerabilities, sensible numerics (epsilon-guarded norms, SVD-based PCA). But the repo has one disqualifying structural problem and a credibility problem in how it validates itself.

**Score: 5.5/10. Approve as-is: No.**

## The two big problems

**1. The repo cannot run as shipped.** `run_extract` (emovec/extract.py:26-27) requires `data/stories/manifest.json` plus per-emotion story files (`data/stories/<emotion>/<topic>_<story>.txt`, emovec/data.py:24-36). There is no `data/` directory anywhere in the repo, and no script that generates the stories. So `make demo`, every command in the README, and the end-to-end test (`tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12`) all crash immediately with `FileNotFoundError`. The committed `outputs/tiny_demo/` artifacts prove the dataset existed on the author's machine — the manifest even embeds its 20 topics — but it was never committed and the README never mentions the prerequisite. Whoever resumes development hits a wall on day one.

**2. The validation is circular in tiny mode.** The tiny backend's `EMOTION_LEXICON` (emovec/model.py:15-32) is hand-copied from the validation scenario texts in `data.py:63-80` — the "afraid" lexicon literally contains "trail", "snapping", "dark" from the afraid scenario; "excited" contains "rocket"; "grief" contains "memorial". On top of that, extraction passes the ground-truth emotion label into the backend (`extract.py:32` → `model.py:147-148`, which adds `2.0 × emotion_vector`). So the headline check — "diagonal mean exceeds off-diagonal mean" — and the integration test's `assert summary["diagonal_gt_off_diagonal"] is True` pass by construction. The test suite gives false confidence: it verifies the demo was rigged correctly, not that the method works.

## Full issue list

| # | File:Lines | Sev | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | emovec/extract.py:26-27 | High | Pipeline requires `data/stories/` which doesn't exist in repo; no generation script provided |
| 2 | tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12 | High | End-to-end test (and `make demo`) crashes on missing dataset — CI can never have passed against this tree |
| 3 | emovec/model.py:15-32, 147-148 | High | Emotion lexicon copied from validation scenarios + ground-truth `label_hint` injected at extraction → validation passes by construction |
| 4 | emovec/elo.py:17-19 | Medium | Magic temperature `/20.0` is calibrated to the tiny backend's 30–128 utility scale; real HF logit diffs (~1–5) collapse to p≈0.5, making Elo separation near-noise on the actual model |
| 5 | emovec/model.py:264-268, 306-308 | Medium | Prompt asks for "a preference score:" but the metric is the first-subtoken logit of `" good"` vs `" bad"` — measurement doesn't match the prompt and is tokenizer-fragile |
| 6 | emovec/model.py:234-240 | Medium | If offsets are unavailable (slow tokenizer) or the activity string isn't found, steering silently falls back to applying the vector to every token in the prompt |
| 7 | emovec/model.py:252-260 | Medium | HF logit lens projects raw residual vectors through `lm_head` without the model's final norm (or Gemma-2 logit softcapping) — token rankings are unfaithful |
| 8 | emovec/steer_prefs.py:45-49 | Medium | If correlations don't split into ≥2 positive and ≥2 negative, the selection silently discards everything and steers `emotions[:4]` instead of topping up |
| 9 | emovec/validate_contexts.py:66-67 | Medium | If "afraid" isn't in the emotion set, code silently uses emotion index 0 but still writes files labeled `afraid_dosage` |
| 10 | README.md:38-51 | Medium | Setup section omits the dataset prerequisite entirely and doesn't mention pytest lives in the optional `test` extra |
| 11 | emovec/model.py:204-213 | Low | `dtype: auto` is never forwarded to HF (`torch_dtype=None` → float32), silently doubling memory for gemma-2-2b |
| 12 | config.yaml:10, 50 | Low | Dead config keys: `data.neutral_corpus` and `steering.min_reported_emotions` are never read (the `4` is hardcoded in steer_prefs.py) |
| 13 | emovec/elo.py:25-28 | Low | Sequential Elo updates over a fixed pair order make ratings order-dependent; a Bradley-Terry fit would be deterministic and principled |
| 14 | emovec/extract.py:19, 34 | Low | Token-start fallback logic duplicated in two places; they can drift apart |
| 15 | emovec/model.py:7 | Low | Unused `Iterable` import |
| 16 | outputs/ | Low | Generated artifacts (.npy, .png, .csv) committed to the repo |

What I did **not** find: any security problems. Config loading uses `yaml.safe_load`, there's no subprocess/eval/network code, and file paths come from config rather than untrusted input.

## Rewrite estimate

The codebase is ~1,000 lines of source plus ~120 of tests. Fixing this properly means: writing the missing story-generation/dataset module (~100–150 new lines), decoupling the tiny backend from the scenario texts (~60), recalibrating or replacing the Elo probability mapping (~25), fixing the HF preference/lens/steering fallbacks (~50), and the smaller cleanups (~20). **Roughly 250 lines new or significantly changed.**

## Bottom line

No, I would not approve this PR as-is. The blocking reasons are that nothing in the repo is runnable without an undocumented, uncommitted dataset, and the test suite's central scientific assertion is satisfied by construction rather than by the method. The underlying engineering is solid enough that this is a focused week of fixes, not a rewrite — but it should not enter active development claiming "the test suite covers the tiny end-to-end pipeline" when that pipeline cannot currently execute.
